correctness.rationale: For the explicitly defined nine-point 9-line (9_3) Pappus hypergraph, the independent reconstruction enumerated all 297 nonempty faces with vector (9,36,81,108,54,9), reconstructed the 143 pairs on the ordinary nonempty face poset, verified all 1071 oriented Hasse covers are acyclic, and found one critical vertex plus ten critical 3-cells. Forman theory gives the UNSUSPENDED integral wedge of ten 3-spheres (no possible positive-dimensional attaching target). Independent enumeration of all 9! point permutations gave exactly 108 incidence automorphisms, agreeing with affine permutations preserving three directions; signed Lefschetz and selected-permutation-cycle counts agree for every group element, yielding trace histogram 10:1,-2:21,-1:36,1:32,2:18, invariant dimension 0 and character square sum 324/108=3. Reproduction: the deterministic independently constructed bitmask and poset checks; source RESULT.md and verify_pappus_noncover.py. No claim of equivariant wedge or point-line duality.
residual_risks: Code was inspected; finite enumeration is exhaustive only for the stated finite objects or finite ranges. No formal Lean/expert certificate exists.
